with UARP.JSON_Support;
with UARP.Types;

package UARP.Models is

   use UARP.Types;

   subtype JSON_Value is UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   --  `UnreadCounter` model.
   type Unread_Counter is record
      Count : UARP.Types.Integer_Value := 0;
      --  Same value, snake_case.
      Unread_Count : UARP.Types.Integer_Value := 0;
      --  Same value, camelCase.
      Unread_Count_X : UARP.Types.Integer_Value := 0;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Unread_Counter) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Unread_Counter;

end UARP.Models;

package body UARP.Models is

   package JS renames UARP.JSON_Support;

   function To_JSON (Model : Unread_Counter) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "count", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Count));
      JS.Set (Result, "unread_count", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Unread_Count));
      JS.Set (Result, "unreadCount", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Unread_Count_X));
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Unread_Counter is
      Result : Unread_Counter;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "count") then
         Result.Count := JS.As_Integer (JS.Get_Value (Node, "count"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "unread_count") then
         Result.Unread_Count := JS.As_Integer (JS.Get_Value (Node, "unread_count"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "unreadCount") then
         Result.Unread_Count_X := JS.As_Integer (JS.Get_Value (Node, "unreadCount"));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

end UARP.Models;

   --  Unread counter served under three spellings at once

   --  The platform's GET /notifications/unread returns `count`, `unread_count` and `unreadCount`
   --  in one object (routes/notifications.ts:238, measured 2026-09-10). Every emitter must keep
   --  all three as distinct fields even where its naming convention folds two of them together.
